condition: subacute localized soft fluctuant 4 cm fluid swelling over the posterior tip of the left elbow for 10 days in a plumber who leans on elbows at work
level_rationale: Ten days of a soft squishy 4 cm fluid pouch over the back tip of the left elbow in a plumber who leans on his elbows during daily pipe work indicates subacute occupational olecranon bursal effusion warranting an outpatient clinic visit for examination, exclusion of septic infection, and targeted compression or aspiration management rather than unguided self-care alone or emergency care, whereas a small red leaning mark on the back tip of the left elbow yesterday that faded within 8 minutes represents harmless transient leaning pressure erythema needing only routine self-care.
